note: The source of split-partition-implicit-case-twins-bind-while-another-split-is-pending, with a split declared for every delivered literal (Kon and KON to 1.5.kon, LEFT to 1.5.left) beside 1.5.other, which no delivered column name derives. The unmatched pin is a stale curation entry, as any curation entry that matches nothing is: one stale_curation_entry error located at sample.toml's [[variable]] 1.5.other, while the matched splits keep their states and the diagnostic build completes. The replaced test's second leg refused an ambiguity with no unresolved native row to explain; the compile (`_partition_ambiguity`, curation_compile.py) no longer mints that ambiguity, so the source-scope refusal it pinned is now an implementation invariant that no curation reaches (steps 1, 4 and 5 crash on it if the compile mints one again). Until this fix the build aborted with `naming_split_unmatched` (before #1346 the bare ValueError `ambiguous naming lacks an unresolved native identity`), even in diagnostic mode, while the pending sibling left the same pin silently unused. Found by #1313.
fails_if: `compile_partitions` (curation_compile.py) stops reporting the unbound split pins that `_partition_ambiguity` returns as unmatched, so 1.5.other is silently unused; or reports them at the register file instead of the [[variable]] entry

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers Kon in 2020 (CVID 20), KON in 2021 (CVID 21) and LEFT in 2021 (CVID 22).
